```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"A Republican administration will restore the nation's credibility.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. must stand up for its friends, challenge its foes, and destroy ISIS.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Hezbollah, controlling over 100,000 missiles in Lebanon, must be isolated and Lebanon's independence restored.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. will support the transition to a post-Assad Syrian government that is representative of its people, protects the rights of all minorities and religions, respects the territorial integrity of its neighbors, and contributes to peace and stability in the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. partnership with the Iraqi people should continue as long as ISIS and others like it survive in the region.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Christian communities in cities like Erbil are receiving no financial support from either the U.S. government or the UN to help with displaced persons and urban refugees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The survival of Christian communities in cities like Erbil is sustained only by private charities.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This lack of support for Christian communities must change immediately.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Defeating ISIS means more than pushing back its fighters while abandoning its victims.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Defeating ISIS must mean aiding those who have suffered the most, and doing so before they starve.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Defeating ISIS must mean supporting the long-term survival of indigenous religious and ethnic communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Defeating ISIS must mean punishing the perpetrators of crimes against humanity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Humanitarian and military assistance to governments should be conditioned on their observable commitment to human rights.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
